author: dreambig5
body:
Go to top right in Orna (it currently says Laborlight), then scroll down & click on Wyrmhunt, switch over to the crafting tab. You should be able to acquire Peluda in exchange for dragon heads.

Alternative would be to find someone with lots of beastiaries like PetShoppe. I think you need to complete the codex first & then it MAY show up in one of those beastiaries where you can purchase it using Orns.
